newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air December load factor up.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air December load factor up.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Inc said Wednesday that its December system-wide passenger load factor rose 2.3 percentage points from a year earlier, to 70.5 percent.
Available seat miles rose 4.8 percent to 7.81 billion, and revenue passenger miles gained 8.3 percent to 5.50 billion.
Cargo ton miles for the month fell 3.6 percent to 187.3 million.

For all of 1996, Northwest's system passenger load factor rose 1.6 points to 73.1 percent. Available seat miles rose 7.4 percent to 93.91 billion, and revenue passenger miles increased 9.8 percent to 68.64 billion.
Cargo ton miles for the year dropped 1.4 percent to 2.22 billion.
